items.tr: buruk tatlı, hem hüzünlü hem güzel
items.example: Leaving the old house was a bittersweet moment.
items.exampleTr: Eski evden ayrılmak buruk bir andı.
items.simple: Happy and sad at the same time.

items.example: I have mixed feelings about moving abroad.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışına taşınmak hakkında karışık duygular içindeyim.
items.simple: You feel good and bad about the same thing.

items.example: His loud chewing really gets on my nerves.
items.exampleTr: Yüksek sesle çiğnemesi gerçekten sinirime dokunuyor.
items.simple: Something makes you feel angry and tired, again and again.

items.example: She felt resentful that nobody had thanked her.
items.exampleTr: Kimsenin ona teşekkür etmemesine içerlemişti.
items.simple: You are angry for a long time because it was not fair.

items.example: I'm a little apprehensive about the interview tomorrow.
items.exampleTr: Yarınki mülakat konusunda biraz tedirginim.
items.simple: A little scared about something that will happen soon.

items.example: He gave a wistful smile when he saw the old photos.
items.exampleTr: Eski fotoğrafları görünce hüzünlü bir gülümseme verdi.
items.simple: A soft sad feeling when you want something from long ago.

items.example: I felt completely deflated after the meeting.
items.exampleTr: Toplantıdan sonra tamamen moralim bozuldu.
items.simple: Your happy feeling goes out like air from a balloon.

items.example: I feel drained after dealing with customers all day.
items.exampleTr: Bütün gün müşterilerle uğraşınca bitkin hissediyorum.
items.simple: You have no strength left, like an empty cup.

items.example: After ten years in the job, she felt jaded.
items.exampleTr: On yıllık işten sonra hevesi kaçmıştı.
items.simple: You did the same thing so long that it is not fun now.

items.example: I'm so envious of your holiday photos!
items.exampleTr: Tatil fotoğraflarına çok imreniyorum!
items.simple: You want what another person has.

items.example: He showed no remorse for what he'd done.
items.exampleTr: Yaptığı şey için hiç pişmanlık göstermedi.
items.simple: A heavy sad feeling because you did something bad.

items.example: I'm at a loss for words. Thank you so much.
items.exampleTr: Söyleyecek söz bulamıyorum. Çok teşekkürler.
items.simple: You do not know what to say or do.

items.example: I'm in two minds about taking the job.
items.exampleTr: İşi kabul etmek konusunda kararsızım.
items.simple: One part of you says yes and the other part says no.

items.example: I had a lump in my throat during his speech.
items.exampleTr: Konuşması sırasında boğazım düğümlendi.
items.simple: Your throat feels tight because you want to cry.

items.example: Don't bottle it up. Talk to someone.
items.exampleTr: İçine atma. Biriyle konuş.
items.simple: You keep your feelings inside and do not tell anyone.

items.example: Sorry I snapped at you earlier. I was stressed.
items.exampleTr: Az önce sana çıkıştığım için üzgünüm. Stresliydim.
items.simple: You talk to someone in a cross, sharp way.

items.example: I felt a pang of guilt when I saw her face.
items.exampleTr: Yüzünü görünce içimde bir vicdan sızısı hissettim.
items.simple: A quick sharp bad feeling because you did something wrong.

items.example: She couldn't hold back her tears any longer.
items.exampleTr: Gözyaşlarını artık tutamadı.
items.simple: You try very hard not to cry.

items.example: I had to swallow my pride and ask for help.
items.exampleTr: Gururumu yutup yardım istemek zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: You do something hard because you must, even if it feels bad.

items.example: I still harbour doubts about the whole idea.
items.exampleTr: Hâlâ tüm bu fikir hakkında şüphe duyuyorum.
items.simple: You keep unsure thoughts in your mind for a long time.

items.en: I can't help feeling… I can't help feeling a bit sad.
items.example: I can't help feeling a little jealous.
items.exampleTr: Biraz kıskanmadan edemiyorum.
items.simple: You feel it and you cannot stop the feeling.

items.en: I don't know whether to laugh or cry. I don't know whether to laugh or cry!
items.example: The results were so strange, I don't know whether to laugh or cry.
items.exampleTr: Sonuçlar o kadar garipti ki gülsem mi ağlasam mı bilemedim.
items.simple: The thing is funny and sad together, so you feel stuck.

items.en: Part of me wants to… Part of me wants to quit.
items.example: Part of me wants to stay, but part of me wants to go.
items.exampleTr: İçimden bir yanım kalmak istiyor, bir yanım gitmek.
items.simple: One little voice inside you wants one thing, another voice wants another.
